packages.name: @kiln/server
packages.purpose: Hono + node:sqlite server: records, devices, hosts, jobs, archives, SSE events, the Anthropic model gateway and the Perf Lab data routes; serves the built workbench page.
packages.notes: 79 tests in 9 files; jobs.test.ts drives the real driver against fake docker/nvidia-smi.

packages.name: @kiln/exec
packages.purpose: Browser-safe execution model: host profiles, facts, requirements, offers, the WorkloadKind/Collector plug-in contracts, two kinds, eleven collectors, the planner and capture identity.

packages.name: @kiln/evidence
packages.purpose: Provenance-carrying values, statistics (bootstrap CI, paired ratio), repetition order, pure-JS sha256, canonical JSON, identities, the kiln-measure/1 record and hypothesis verdicts.
packages.notes: Zero runtime dependencies, no node: imports, 133 tests; consumed by four packages.

duplications.title: Perf Lab server ported into apps/server and @kiln/exec
duplications.description: lab-workbench/server is frozen since its import (92daa13); Kiln is canonical. difflib ratios: tar 0.73, events 0.73, importer→perf-lab-sampler 0.65, datasets 0.64, evidence 0.64, db 0.39, store 0.18; app, runner and assistant are separate designs (≤0.11).
duplications.suggested_consolidation: Retire lab-workbench/server once qualification evidence has a home in Kiln.

duplications.title: Perf Lab schema 5: three copies
duplications.description: The importer test fixture builds a Perf Lab store from a hand copy of schema 5.
duplications.suggested_consolidation: Generate the fixture from lab-workbench/server/db.ts, or drop it with the importer.

duplications.title: cyrb53 + stableStringify: three bit-identical copies
duplications.description: Must stay bit-identical or imported capture hashes stop verifying (importer.ts:222).
duplications.suggested_consolidation: One export from @kiln/evidence, with a golden-vector test.

duplications.title: SHA-256 helpers beside @kiln/evidence
duplications.description: @kiln/evidence sha256Hex is pure JS; three server sites use node:crypto directly.
duplications.suggested_consolidation: Keep node:crypto for speed but behind one server helper.

duplications.title: Archive registration: two paths, two limits, two directories
duplications.description: lab/evidence.ts registerArchive extracts and registers datasets (64 MiB cap); exec/jobs.ts:434 lists only (2 GiB read limit, 1 GiB plan limit). GET /archives/:sha searches both directories.
duplications.suggested_consolidation: One archive store with one limit and one directory.

duplications.title: HostView wire type re-declared
duplications.description: No shared type package; the page reads hosts untyped.
duplications.suggested_consolidation: Export the wire types from @kiln/exec (or a kiln-api types package).

complexity_hotspots.reason: Seven states over eight methods, two schedulers, resumable long-poll, budget cancel ends as failed, a replan edge missing from its diagram; restart correctness needs driver_seq, submitted_at and plan files to agree.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Make the transition table explicit data and test every edge; decide what replan does.

complexity_hotspots.reason: Migration 3 rewrites migration 2 tables and seeds captures from lab_artifacts; stale comments; unused sources and devices.spec_json.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Drop dead columns/tables in migration 4; fix the comments.

complexity_hotspots.reason: Kinds and collectors go wrong at the shape/disturbs/exclusive/companion contract; nvtx and stage-timers registered but unusable.
Largest kind; half is a port of Perf Lab importer.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Move the importer port beside the kind contract.

complexity_hotspots.reason: One-shot migration tool that must track two schemas.
complexity_hotspots.suggestion: Retire after the last Perf Lab store is imported.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: Every non-GET /api route requires X-Kiln-Token; Host and Origin are checked.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: An agent-proposed job cannot be approved by the agent (403 agent_cannot_approve) and agent jobs share a 24-hour executor budget (429 agent_budget_exhausted).

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: The replan edge approved→proposed (jobs.ts:345-351) keeps the old plan file; re-approving re-submits the same plan, which replans again. Approval cannot be bypassed (approve only from proposed), but the edge is a dead end.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: A budget-forced cancellation ends as failed, not cancelled.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: Job submission is serial per host; the driver additionally serialises steps under a GPU flock.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: loadHosts refuses to start while the data directory still holds the retired executors.json.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: DriverClient.jobs() has no caller: the server never reconciles driver-side jobs it lost.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: The execution core imports helpers of the Perf Lab port (lab/files.ts, lab/tar.ts, lab/store.ts pack).

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: apps/server/README.md documents executors, KILN_EXECUTORS, pnpm dev/serve and 501 lab routes that do not exist; executors were deleted in 49f5156.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: The sources table is never read or written; devices.spec_json is never written.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: CatalogEntry.origin admits job but is always measured.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: lab/import.ts help claims jobs are copied; the importer skips jobs, synthetic artifacts and transcripts.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: Kiln registers only COCO datasets from evidence archives; detection-qualification/v1 evidence is not recognised (PL/qualification.ts not ported).

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: The model gateway stores no transcripts and runs no tools; Perf Lab’s pi-coding-agent assistant (difflib 0.07) was not ported.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: jobs.test.ts runs the real kiln_driver.py against fake docker, nvidia-smi and nvcc binaries, so the driver protocol is tested end to end without a GPU.

facts.subject: @kiln/server
facts.fact: Live snapshot 2026-10-21: 3 migrations, hosts mac (127.0.0.1:5381, CPU) and bling (127.0.0.1:5481, GB10), 20 jobs all done (16 bling, 4 mac), 21 archives, one device with 12 records.

facts.subject: @kiln/exec
facts.fact: packages/exec is browser-safe: no node: import anywhere in src.

facts.subject: @kiln/exec
facts.fact: KINDS holds exactly kiln-kernels/1 and perf-lab-sampler/1; kiln-probe/1 and kiln-program/1 exist only in the design doc.

facts.subject: @kiln/exec
facts.fact: The nvtx and stage-timers collectors are registered but never usable: no registered kind cooperates.

facts.subject: @kiln/exec
facts.fact: ncu and nsys collectors are implemented although KILN-003 tasks.md lists P2 as open.

facts.subject: @kiln/exec
facts.fact: Capture identity is sha256 of canonical {format: kiln-capture/1, kind, content, collectors, protocol, device, environment}; cyrb53 survives only as lab_hash.

facts.subject: @kiln/exec
facts.fact: When ncu is requested the planner adds a timing companion step, because counters disturb timing.

facts.subject: @kiln/exec
facts.fact: kiln-bundle/1 still carries ncu: false, which kiln_runner.py no longer reads.

facts.subject: @kiln/exec
facts.fact: Observation types 'program' and 'device-spec' and WorkloadKind.nvtxRange have no producer.

facts.subject: @kiln/evidence
facts.fact: @kiln/evidence has zero runtime dependencies, no node: imports, and 133 tests in nine files.

facts.subject: runner
facts.fact: kiln_driver.py is unauthenticated plain HTTP by decision; it must bind the one address the server reaches (loopback + ssh tunnel in this deployment).

facts.subject: runner
facts.fact: Each step runs as docker run --rm --init --network <profile, default none> --user uid:gid with the bundle mounted read-only; the GPU lock is fcntl.flock on /run/lock/kiln-gpu-<uuid>.lock.

facts.subject: runner
facts.fact: The archive’s events.ndjson is packed before the final result event, so it lacks it.

facts.subject: runner
facts.fact: PUT /v1/self replaces the driver source after a compile check and re-execs; the server pushes it when the remote sha256 differs and the driver is idle.

diagrams.title: Kiln job state machine
diagrams.source:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> proposed
  proposed --> approved: approve
  approved --> proposed: replan (image mismatch)
  approved --> running: driver.started
  running --> importing: result
  importing --> done
  importing --> failed: importer refused
  running --> failed: driver failed / budget
  proposed --> cancelled: cancel
  approved --> cancelled: cancel
  running --> cancelled: cancel

diagrams.title: Kiln job end to end
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant P as page / lab UI
  participant S as apps/server Jobs
  participant X as @kiln/exec
  participant D as kiln_driver.py
  P->>S: POST /api/jobs
  S->>D: POST /v1/probe (TTL 10 min)
  D-->>S: kiln-facts/1
  S->>X: planJob
  X-->>S: kiln-plan/1
  P->>S: POST /api/jobs/:id/approve
  S->>D: HEAD/PUT /v1/blobs/:sha
  S->>D: POST /v1/jobs
  loop long-poll
    S->>D: GET events?after=seq
  end
  D-->>S: result {sha256}
  S->>D: GET archive
  S->>S: importArchive → captures, runs, records
  S->>D: DELETE /v1/jobs/:id
